convention: One register for every team the pilot has flown, in any room. A row points at the unit; the unit holds the whole team, including the room it flew in. Seat identity (agent type, model) is in ../../team/crew/MANIFEST-crew.json; a seat in a unit is name, reason, returns. Ids are counted across the whole register, assigned once, never renumbered.

units.summary: Dispatch to recon flightcrew's terrain, history and doctrine, verify harness claims against official documentation, and cut candidate epic missions.
Dispatch of a certified research team to turn the recon and genesis sources into records, contested and verified, run past the commander before landing.
Dispatch of two critics over the day's cockpit work and the approved plan, one on fit with the cockpit's purpose, one on bulk that can be trimmed.
Dispatch of the first agent team: cockpit cleanup suggestions, official best practice, and an adversary over both.
Dispatch to review CLAUDE.md against official documentation, comb the cockpit for what belongs there, and judge and redraft the file.
Dispatch of a strengthened research team to mine the commander's statements into timeless topics and distil validated records under the docspec.
Dispatch of a one-shot doc-reviewer over the records docspec in CLAUDE.md rule 2 and the records README.
Dispatch of a mini-adversary pass over the teams integration: dispatch JSON per room, rosters, crew rooms and seat dossiers.
Dispatch of a decision team on how the cockpit keeps records, later extended to the procedures room scaffold, the rule 2 wording and the four stubs.
Dispatch to explore the commander's idea files with him in the room: cockpit rooms, identifiers, manifests and units, and frontmatter, as one scheme.
Dispatch to build stage A of the paperwork check: the store, a reference checker, a rename tool with a dry run, and a table test over fixtures.
Dispatch of the mini adversaries over the stage A work for fit and trim, with the verdict left to them while T011 was held.
Dispatch of a quick team to check whether what the commander advised and what was built align, deciding the way forward with T012's findings.
Dispatch to refit the cockpit: schemas and a Node linter, the identifier pass, JSON manifests and units, frontmatter, and the five-room move.
